name: 74AHC244PW-Q100,11
title: Automotive octal buffer/line driver with 3-state outputs
summary: Eight non-inverting buffers with 3-state outputs, split into two groups of four, each group with its own active-low enable (1OE, 2OE); a high enable puts that group's outputs in high impedance. The 74AHC244-Q100 has CMOS input thresholds and runs from 2.0 V to 5.5 V; the 74AHCT244-Q100 has TTL thresholds and runs from 4.5 V to 5.5 V. Every input has Schmitt-trigger action and is overvoltage tolerant to 5.5 V, so the parts can serve as translators between mixed logic voltages. Both are AEC-Q100 Grade 1 qualified, rated -40 °C to +125 °C, in SO20, TSSOP20 and DHVQFN20.

circuits.title: Test circuit for switching times
circuits.description: The load and source used for the propagation, enable and disable times. A pulse generator, terminated by RT matched to its own output impedance, drives the input under test. The output under test carries CL to ground and RL to S1, which leaves RL open for tPLH/tPHL, returns it to GND for tPZH/tPHZ and to VCC for tPZL/tPLZ. VI is VCC for the 74AHC244-Q100 and 3.0 V for the 74AHCT244-Q100, with 3.0 ns edges, CL of 15 pF or 50 pF and RL of 1 kΩ.

equations.name: Dynamic power dissipation
equations.expr: PD = CPD × VCC² × fi + Σ(CL × VCC² × fo)

where.CPD: power dissipation capacitance, pF (10 pF typ 74AHC244-Q100, 12 pF typ 74AHCT244-Q100)
where.CL: load capacitance on each output, pF

equations.note: The sum runs over all switching outputs.

equations.name: Power dissipation derating
equations.expr: Ptot = 500 mW - k × (Tamb - Tk), for Tamb > Tk

operation.text: 1OE governs outputs 1Y0 to 1Y3 and 2OE governs 2Y0 to 2Y3. With its enable low a group passes each A input to its Y output without inversion; with the enable high the four outputs float. The device works as two 4-bit buffers or as one 8-bit buffer.

Every input has Schmitt-trigger hysteresis and is overvoltage tolerant to 5.5 V, which lets the part serve as a translator between logic voltages; input leakage is specified for VCC from 0 V to 5.5 V. The 74AHC244-Q100 switches at CMOS levels; the 74AHCT244-Q100 at TTL levels (VIH 2.0 V, VIL 0.8 V).
On the 74AHCT244-Q100 an input held at VCC - 2.1 V instead of a rail draws extra supply current, ΔICC, up to 1.35 mA per input at 25 °C and 1.5 mA across temperature.
Input rise and fall rate is limited to 100 ns/V at VCC = 3.3 V and 20 ns/V at VCC = 5.0 V.

Total dissipation is 500 mW from -40 °C to +125 °C, derated linearly above 109 °C (SO20), 100 °C (TSSOP20) or 111 °C (DHVQFN20). Supply and ground current are each limited to 75 mA and each output to ±25 mA.

The exposed pad of the DHVQFN20 is not a ground connection and needs no soldering; a soldered pad's land is left unconnected or joined to GND. The package has side-wettable flanks so the solder joints can be inspected optically.
